book.subtitle: Survive the void. Brave the rotating gateway. Grow your island.
book.title: Dimensional Chaos
chapter.automation.description: Expand your Skyblock island with automated resource processing, redstone contraptions, and storage.
chapter.automation.subtitle: Automate your island
chapter.automation.title: Chapter 3 - Automation
chapter.dimensional_explorer.description: Each island expansion opens harsher realms to your gateway: Twilight Forest, Aether, Nether, Undergarden, the Mining World, then the End. A realm your chapter needs comes first.
chapter.dimensional_explorer.subtitle: Conquer hostile realms
chapter.dimensional_explorer.title: Chapter 5 - Dimensional Explorer
chapter.dimensional_mastery.description: Complete high-stakes expeditions, defeat the bosses of the dimensions, and claim mastery over Dimensional Chaos.
chapter.dimensional_mastery.subtitle: The hardest trials of the rotating realms
chapter.dimensional_mastery.title: Chapter 6 - Dimensional Mastery
chapter.island_tier_1.description: Main objectives (top row) expand your island. Round quests below are optional bonuses.
Tip: pin a quest in the quest book to keep it on screen.
chapter.island_tier_1.subtitle: Gather your first resources, craft tools and come back from a dimensional expedition.
chapter.island_tier_1.title: Expansion 1 - First Steps
chapter.island_tier_2.description: Your gateway now also reaches the Aether. Expeditions get a little more dangerous with each island expansion.
chapter.island_tier_2.subtitle: Iron tools, a shield and a proper visit to the Twilight Forest.
chapter.island_tier_2.title: Expansion 2 - Survivor's Island
chapter.island_tier_3.description: From now on the gateway can open to the Nether. Bring a shield, food and a bucket.
chapter.island_tier_3.subtitle: The Nether opens to your gateway, and your first magical essences.
chapter.island_tier_3.title: Expansion 3 - Mystical Roots
chapter.island_tier_4.description: Create machines run on rotation: a water wheel turns shafts and cogwheels that power your machines.
chapter.island_tier_4.subtitle: Create: rotation, the first press and the first machines.
chapter.island_tier_4.title: Expansion 4 - Gears & Steam
chapter.island_tier_5.description: Magic mods add spells and enchanting machines. The OneBlock turns arcane: lapis and archwood.
Your gateway now reaches the Undergarden and goes there first while this chapter needs it.
chapter.island_tier_5.subtitle: Magic: Ars Nouveau, Iron's Spells and the depths of the Undergarden.
chapter.island_tier_5.title: Expansion 5 - Arcane Studies
chapter.island_tier_6.description: Electric machines double your ore output and automate your island. The OneBlock's Industry phase brings osmium and uraninite.
Your gateway now reaches the Mining World and goes there first while this chapter needs it.
chapter.island_tier_6.subtitle: Mekanism machines, Powah energy and the Mining World.
chapter.island_tier_6.title: Expansion 6 - Industrial Void
chapter.island_tier_7.description: The End opens at island tier 6. Your gateway goes first to the End, then to the Nether, while this chapter needs them.
Expeditions are dangerous now: prepare armour, food and fragments.
chapter.island_tier_7.subtitle: Harsher realms: the End, the Nether's fortresses and the Wither's skulls.
chapter.island_tier_7.title: Expansion 7 - Beyond the Fracture
chapter.island_tier_8.description: Warning: summon the Wither far from your island. It destroys blocks.
chapter.island_tier_8.subtitle: The Wither, a beacon and elite machines.
chapter.island_tier_8.title: Expansion 8 - Dimensional Mastery
chapter.lost_beyond_the_portal.descripti: Stay out longer than your 15 minutes and your return gateway collapses. A Dimensional Fracture then appears nearby: repair it to come home.
chapter.lost_beyond_the_portal.subtitle: Survive being trapped
chapter.lost_beyond_the_portal.title: Side chapter - Lost Beyond the Portal
chapter.magic_and_technology.description: Prepare high-tier enchantments, potions, and emergency rift kits to survive progressive dimensional danger.
chapter.magic_and_technology.subtitle: Prepare for deeper expeditions
chapter.magic_and_technology.title: Chapter 4 - Magic and Technology
chapter.the_dimensional_gateway.descript: Every cycle the gateway turns to another realm and stays open during the day. Your return portal stays open 15 minutes from your own entry; coming back and leaving again in the same cycle uses the time you have left.
The panel on screen shows the cycle, where your gateway leads and how long your return portal stays open.
chapter.the_dimensional_gateway.subtitle: Brave the rotating gateway
chapter.the_dimensional_gateway.title: Chapter 2 - The Dimensional Gateway
chapter.the_void.description: Your island starts as a single OneBlock above the void. Break it again and again: it comes back with new blocks, and its drops go straight into your inventory.
Inventory full? Drops go to the 6-slot OneBlock reserve: sneak + right-click the OneBlock with an empty hand. When both are full, drops fall to the ground.
chapter.the_void.subtitle: Survival on your OneBlock island
chapter.the_void.title: Chapter 1 - The Void
group.expeditions.title: Story: Expeditions
group.island_expansion.title: Island Expansion
group.mastery.title: Story: Mastery
group.skyblock_core.title: Story: the Void & the Gateway
quest.automation/auto_crafter.descriptio: A Crafter crafts by itself when powered by redstone.
quest.automation/auto_crafter.subtitle: Build a Redstone Crafter
quest.automation/auto_crafter.title: Automated Crafting
quest.automation/iron_production.descrip: Smelt iron from the OneBlock and craft a hopper to start automating.
quest.automation/iron_production.title: Metallurgy & Hoppers
quest.dimensional_explorer/crimson_and_w: Crying obsidian and glowstone come from ruined portals, bartering with piglins and Nether ceilings.
quest.dimensional_explorer/end_expeditio: When your gateway opens to the End (island tier 6 or more), gather End Stone.
quest.dimensional_explorer/nether_expedi: When your gateway opens to the Nether (island tier 2 or more), find a fortress and hunt blazes.
Brave the Nether during a gateway cycle
quest.dimensional_mastery/master_of_chao: Defeat the Wither and keep its Nether Star.
quest.dimensional_mastery/slay_dragon.de: When your gateway opens to the End (island tier 6 or more), slay the Ender Dragon. It takes several expeditions: the fight resumes where you left it.
quest.dimensional_mastery/slay_dragon.su: Defeat the Ender Dragon during an expedition
quest.island_tier_1/island_tier_1.descri: Complete the 6 required quests of this chapter to expand your island border from radius 16 to 24.
Optional quests give extra rewards but never block an expansion.
The whole team shares the larger island. Nothing you built is changed.
quest.island_tier_1/island_tier_1.title: Island Expansion 1
quest.island_tier_1/t1_bread.description: Hay bales from the OneBlock break into wheat. Three wheat make a bread.
quest.island_tier_1/t1_bread.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_1/t1_bread.title: Daily Bread
quest.island_tier_1/t1_bricks.descriptio: Clay blocks come from the OneBlock. Smelt clay balls into bricks.
quest.island_tier_1/t1_bricks.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_1/t1_bricks.title: Clay into Brick
quest.island_tier_1/t1_bridge.descriptio: The glowing Dimensional Gateway floats a few blocks from your OneBlock. Build a path of dirt to reach it, without falling into the void.
Tip: sneak (Shift) at the edge to place blocks safely.
quest.island_tier_1/t1_bridge.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_1/t1_bridge.title: Bridge to the Gateway
quest.island_tier_1/t1_coal.description: After 128 blocks, or as soon as your island reaches tier 1, the OneBlock enters the Survival phase: coal, copper and iron start to appear.
quest.island_tier_1/t1_coal.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_1/t1_coal.title: Fuel
quest.island_tier_1/t1_copper.descriptio: Mine copper ore with a stone pickaxe and smelt it.
quest.island_tier_1/t1_copper.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_1/t1_copper.title: First Metal
quest.island_tier_1/t1_enter_gateway.des: Step into the gateway while it is open (the day of each cycle, see the panel on screen).
A Return Gateway appears where you arrive: it is your way home for 15 minutes from your entry.
quest.island_tier_1/t1_first_logs.descri: Break the OneBlock under your feet again and again: it comes back each time with a new block.
Everything it drops goes straight into your inventory. The very first blocks are dirt and four oak logs.
quest.island_tier_1/t1_first_logs.title: First Logs
quest.island_tier_1/t1_furnace.descripti: Eight cobblestone make a furnace. Smelt logs into charcoal for fuel and torches.
quest.island_tier_1/t1_furnace.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_1/t1_furnace.title: Fire in the Void
quest.island_tier_1/t1_moss.description: Moss spreads with bone meal and makes your island greener.
quest.island_tier_1/t1_moss.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_1/t1_moss.title: Green Ground
quest.island_tier_1/t1_return_home.descr: Use your Return Gateway before your 15 minutes run out ("Return portal:" on the panel).
If you are too late it collapses and you must repair a Dimensional Fracture to come back: keep these two fragments for that.
quest.island_tier_1/t1_return_home.title: Home in Time
quest.island_tier_1/t1_saplings.descript: Plant a sapling on dirt: a tree is renewable wood. Potted saplings from the OneBlock give saplings.
quest.island_tier_1/t1_saplings.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_1/t1_saplings.title: A Second Tree
quest.island_tier_1/t1_stone_pick.descri: Turn logs into planks, make a crafting table, sticks and a wooden pickaxe, then mine stone for cobblestone.
No pickaxe yet? You can still punch through stone: it just gives nothing, and wood always comes back.
quest.island_tier_1/t1_stone_pick.title: Stone Tools
quest.island_tier_2/island_tier_2.descri: Complete the 4 required quests of this chapter to expand your island border from radius 24 to 32.
Optional quests give extra rewards but never block an expansion.
The whole team shares the larger island. Nothing you built is changed.
quest.island_tier_2/island_tier_2.title: Island Expansion 2
quest.island_tier_2/t2_bed.description: A bed sets your spawn point. Sleeping skips the night without changing the dimensional cycle.
quest.island_tier_2/t2_bed.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_2/t2_bed.title: A Real Bed
quest.island_tier_2/t2_bucket.descriptio: Three iron ingots. Water from the Twilight Forest, lava from the Nether later.
quest.island_tier_2/t2_bucket.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_2/t2_bucket.title: A Bucket
quest.island_tier_2/t2_composter.descrip: Turns extra seeds and saplings into bone meal.
quest.island_tier_2/t2_composter.title: Compost
quest.island_tier_2/t2_iron.description: Iron ore appears in the Survival phase. Mine it with a stone pickaxe and smelt it.
quest.island_tier_2/t2_iron.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_2/t2_iron.title: Iron Supply
quest.island_tier_2/t2_iron_pick.descrip: Needed for diamonds, gold and many modded ores.
quest.island_tier_2/t2_iron_pick.title: Iron Pickaxe
quest.island_tier_2/t2_melons.descriptio: Melon blocks come from the OneBlock in the Survival phase.
quest.island_tier_2/t2_melons.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_2/t2_melons.title: Melon Patch
quest.island_tier_2/t2_shield.descriptio: One iron ingot and planks. Right-click to block arrows and hits during expeditions.
quest.island_tier_2/t2_shield.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_2/t2_shield.title: Raise a Shield
quest.island_tier_2/t2_skeletons.descrip: Skeletons drop bones: bone meal for your trees.
quest.island_tier_2/t2_skeletons.title: Archers
quest.island_tier_2/t2_spiders.descripti: Four string make a wool block: there are no sheep on your island.
quest.island_tier_2/t2_spiders.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_2/t2_spiders.title: String
quest.island_tier_2/t2_sponge.descriptio: Smelt a wet sponge from the OneBlock.
quest.island_tier_2/t2_sponge.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_2/t2_sponge.title: Dry Sponge
quest.island_tier_2/t2_twilight.descript: The Twilight Forest is always open to young islands. It has water, animals (leather, wool, food) and plenty of wood.
Bring a bucket back full of water: two water sources make an infinite water pool on your island.
quest.island_tier_2/t2_twilight.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_2/t2_twilight.title: Into the Twilight
quest.island_tier_2/t2_zombies.descripti: Monsters spawn on your dark builds at night and around you during expeditions. Light up your island with torches.
quest.island_tier_2/t2_zombies.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_2/t2_zombies.title: Night Watch
quest.island_tier_3/island_tier_3.descri: Complete the 4 required quests of this chapter to expand your island border from radius 32 to 40.
Optional quests give extra rewards but never block an expansion.
The whole team shares the larger island. Nothing you built is changed.
quest.island_tier_3/island_tier_3.title: Island Expansion 3
quest.island_tier_3/t3_blazes.descriptio: Blazes live in Nether fortresses. Find one within a single 15-minute expedition.
quest.island_tier_3/t3_blazes.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_3/t3_blazes.title: Blaze Rods
quest.island_tier_3/t3_books.description: Paper from sugar cane, leather from Twilight Forest animals.
quest.island_tier_3/t3_books.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_3/t3_books.title: Books
quest.island_tier_3/t3_diamonds.descript: The Engineering phase (island tier 3, or 512 blocks) opens with three diamond ores in a row.
quest.island_tier_3/t3_diamonds.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_3/t3_diamonds.title: Diamonds
quest.island_tier_3/t3_enchanting.title: Enchanting Table
quest.island_tier_3/t3_farmland.descript: Inferium farmland makes Mystical Agriculture crops more productive. Right-click tilled farmland with inferium essence (or craft a hoe + inferium essence + dirt), then look at it.
quest.island_tier_3/t3_farmland.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_3/t3_farmland.title: Enriched Soil
quest.island_tier_3/t3_gold.description: Nether gold ore gives nuggets; the OneBlock gives gold ore in later phases.
quest.island_tier_3/t3_gold.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_3/t3_gold.title: Gold
quest.island_tier_3/t3_inferium.descript: Every monster has a 20% chance to drop Inferium Essence, the base of Mystical Agriculture.
quest.island_tier_3/t3_inferium.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_3/t3_inferium.title: Inferium
quest.island_tier_3/t3_inferium_seeds.de: 8 Inferium Essence around wheat seeds. Planted on farmland, they grow more essence by themselves.
Better seeds and essences need prosperity shards: prosperity ore appears in the OneBlock's Engineering phase (island tier 3, or 512 blocks) and as Nether prosperity ore in the Nether.
quest.island_tier_3/t3_nether.descriptio: When your island reaches tier 2, the gateway can open to the Nether. Lava, ghasts and fortresses: be careful.
quest.island_tier_3/t3_nether.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_3/t3_nether.title: The Nether
quest.island_tier_3/t3_obsidian.descript: Pour water onto still lava: a lava bucket from the Nether and water from the Twilight Forest.
quest.island_tier_3/t3_obsidian.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_3/t3_obsidian.title: Obsidian
quest.island_tier_3/t3_quartz.descriptio: Nether quartz ore is everywhere in netherrack. Quartz + cobblestone make diorite, the start of andesite for Create.
quest.island_tier_3/t3_quartz.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_3/t3_quartz.title: Nether Quartz
quest.island_tier_4/island_tier_4.descri: Complete the 5 required quests of this chapter to expand your island border from radius 40 to 48.
Optional quests give extra rewards but never block an expansion.
The whole team shares the larger island. Nothing you built is changed.
quest.island_tier_4/island_tier_4.title: Island Expansion 4
quest.island_tier_4/t4_andesite_alloy.de: Andesite + iron or zinc nuggets. Andesite = diorite + cobblestone; diorite = quartz + cobblestone.
quest.island_tier_4/t4_basin.description: Mixers and presses work on items placed in a basin.
quest.island_tier_4/t4_basin.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_4/t4_basin.title: Basin
quest.island_tier_4/t4_brass.description: Copper + zinc mixed over a blaze burner (heated mixing).
quest.island_tier_4/t4_brass.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_4/t4_brass.title: Brass
quest.island_tier_4/t4_cogs.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_4/t4_cogs.title: Cogwheels
quest.island_tier_4/t4_fan.description: Fans wash, smoke or smelt items in bulk.
quest.island_tier_4/t4_fan.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_4/t4_fan.title: Encased Fan
quest.island_tier_4/t4_mechanism.descrip: Made by sequenced assembly with a deployer, a press and a saw.
quest.island_tier_4/t4_mechanism.title: Precision Mechanism
quest.island_tier_4/t4_millstone.descrip: Grinds cobblestone into gravel and gravel into sand.
quest.island_tier_4/t4_millstone.title: Millstone
quest.island_tier_4/t4_mixer.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_4/t4_mixer.title: Mechanical Mixer
quest.island_tier_4/t4_press.description: Presses ingots into plates. Needs an andesite casing (alloy on stripped wood) and an iron block.
quest.island_tier_4/t4_press.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_4/t4_press.title: Mechanical Press
quest.island_tier_4/t4_shafts.descriptio: Shafts carry rotation in a straight line.
quest.island_tier_4/t4_shafts.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_4/t4_shafts.title: Shafts
quest.island_tier_4/t4_water_wheel.descr: Place it next to flowing water: your first source of rotation.
quest.island_tier_4/t4_water_wheel.title: Water Wheel
quest.island_tier_4/t4_zinc.description: Zinc ore appears in the OneBlock's Engineering phase: it starts when your island reaches tier 3 (or after 512 blocks).
quest.island_tier_4/t4_zinc.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_4/t4_zinc.title: Zinc
quest.island_tier_5/island_tier_5.descri: Complete the 4 required quests of this chapter to expand your island border from radius 48 to 56.
Optional quests give extra rewards but never block an expansion.
The whole team shares the larger island. Nothing you built is changed.
quest.island_tier_5/island_tier_5.title: Island Expansion 5
quest.island_tier_5/t5_aether.descriptio: Floating islands in the sky. Watch your step: falling is the main danger.
quest.island_tier_5/t5_aether.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_5/t5_aether.title: The Aether
quest.island_tier_5/t5_apparatus.descrip: The heart of Ars Nouveau crafting rituals.
quest.island_tier_5/t5_apparatus.title: Enchanting Apparatus
quest.island_tier_5/t5_arcane_essence.de: An Iron's Spells charm: four leather around an amethyst shard (sieve gravel through a compressed sieve).
quest.island_tier_5/t5_archwood.descript: Magical wood from the OneBlock's Arcane phase (island tier 4, or 1536 blocks).
quest.island_tier_5/t5_archwood.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_5/t5_archwood.title: Archwood
quest.island_tier_5/t5_imbuement.descrip: Turns amethyst and other items into magical materials with Source.
quest.island_tier_5/t5_imbuement.title: Imbuement Chamber
quest.island_tier_5/t5_inscription.descr: Iron's Spells: inscribe scrolls into your spell book.
quest.island_tier_5/t5_inscription.title: Inscription Table
quest.island_tier_5/t5_lapis.description: The OneBlock's Arcane phase starts at island tier 4 (or 1536 blocks) with lapis ore; an Ex Deorum sieve with an iron mesh also finds it in gravel.
quest.island_tier_5/t5_lapis.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_5/t5_lapis.title: Lapis
quest.island_tier_5/t5_scribe.descriptio: Learn new glyphs for your spells.
quest.island_tier_5/t5_scribe.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_5/t5_scribe.title: Scribe's Table
quest.island_tier_5/t5_source_gems.title: Source Gems
quest.island_tier_5/t5_source_jar.title: Source Jar
quest.island_tier_5/t5_sourcelink.title: Agronomic Sourcelink
quest.island_tier_5/t5_spell_book.descri: Your first Ars Nouveau spell book: write spells from glyphs.
quest.island_tier_5/t5_spell_book.title: Novice Spell Book
quest.island_tier_5/t5_undergarden.descr: Island tier 4 opens the Undergarden: your gateway goes there first while this chapter needs it.
Dark caverns and tough native mobs: bring torches, a shield and food.
quest.island_tier_5/t5_undergarden.title: Under the World
quest.island_tier_6/island_tier_6.descri: Complete the 6 required quests of this chapter to expand your island border from radius 56 to 64.
Optional quests give extra rewards but never block an expansion.
The whole team shares the larger island. Nothing you built is changed.
quest.island_tier_6/island_tier_6.title: Island Expansion 6
quest.island_tier_6/t6_cables.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_6/t6_cables.title: Universal Cables
quest.island_tier_6/t6_circuits.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_6/t6_circuits.title: Basic Circuits
quest.island_tier_6/t6_crusher.descripti: Cobblestone to gravel to sand, automatically.
quest.island_tier_6/t6_crusher.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_6/t6_crusher.title: Crusher
quest.island_tier_6/t6_energized_steel.d: Iron + gold in an energizing orb.
quest.island_tier_6/t6_energy_cube.title: Energy Cube
quest.island_tier_6/t6_enrichment.title: Enrichment Chamber
quest.island_tier_6/t6_furnator.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_6/t6_furnator.title: Furnator
quest.island_tier_6/t6_infuser.descripti: Infuses metals with carbon or redstone: steel, alloys and circuits.
quest.island_tier_6/t6_infuser.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_6/t6_infuser.title: Metallurgic Infuser
quest.island_tier_6/t6_mining.descriptio: Island tier 5 opens Allthemodium's Mining World: your gateway goes there first while this chapter needs it.
Large ore veins and diamonds; its rarest ores need better pickaxes than you have yet.
quest.island_tier_6/t6_mining.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_6/t6_mining.title: The Mining World
quest.island_tier_6/t6_orb.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_6/t6_orb.title: Energizing Orb
quest.island_tier_6/t6_osmium.descriptio: Osmium ore appears in the OneBlock's Industry phase (island tier 5, or 4096 blocks), or from sieving. This expansion gives you four ingots.
quest.island_tier_6/t6_osmium.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_6/t6_osmium.title: Osmium
quest.island_tier_6/t6_steel.description: Iron infused with carbon (coal or charcoal).
quest.island_tier_6/t6_steel.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_6/t6_steel.title: Steel
quest.island_tier_6/t6_uraninite.descrip: Powah's uraninite appears in the Industry phase.
quest.island_tier_6/t6_uraninite.title: Uraninite
quest.island_tier_7/island_tier_7.descri: Complete the 3 required quests of this chapter to expand your island border from radius 64 to 72.
Optional quests give extra rewards but never block an expansion.
The whole team shares the larger island. Nothing you built is changed.
quest.island_tier_7/island_tier_7.title: Island Expansion 7
quest.island_tier_7/t7_cloggrum.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_7/t7_cloggrum.title: Cloggrum
quest.island_tier_7/t7_debris.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_7/t7_debris.title: Ancient Debris
quest.island_tier_7/t7_end.description: Void all around, Endermen everywhere. Do not look them in the eyes.
quest.island_tier_7/t7_end.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_7/t7_end.title: The End
quest.island_tier_7/t7_end_stone.descrip: A good building block that dragons cannot destroy.
quest.island_tier_7/t7_end_stone.title: End Stone
quest.island_tier_7/t7_endermen.descript: Endermen live in the End and in warped forests of the Nether.
quest.island_tier_7/t7_endermen.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_7/t7_endermen.title: Ender Pearls
quest.island_tier_7/t7_netherite.descrip: Four scraps and four gold ingots.
quest.island_tier_7/t7_netherite.title: Netherite
quest.island_tier_7/t7_steeleaf.descript: Liveroot (Twilight Forest roots), raw iron and a gold nugget make raw ironwood; smelt it.
quest.island_tier_7/t7_steeleaf.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_7/t7_steeleaf.title: Ironwood
quest.island_tier_7/t7_undergarden.descr: A dark world under the world. Bring light.
quest.island_tier_7/t7_undergarden.title: The Undergarden
They guard Nether fortresses and sometimes drop their skull (Looting helps). The next expansion gives you the three skulls the Wither needs.
quest.island_tier_7/t7_zanite.descriptio: The Aether's blue gem, for Aether tools.
quest.island_tier_7/t7_zanite.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_7/t7_zanite.title: Zanite
quest.island_tier_8/island_tier_8.descri: Complete the 4 required quests of this chapter to expand your island border from radius 72 to 80.
Optional quests give extra rewards but never block an expansion.
The whole team shares the larger island. Nothing you built is changed.
quest.island_tier_8/island_tier_8.title: Island Expansion 8
quest.island_tier_8/t8_archmage.descript: An apprentice book, ender pearls, emeralds, a totem of undying, a nether star and a Wilden tribute.
quest.island_tier_8/t8_archmage.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_8/t8_archmage.title: Archmage Spell Book
quest.island_tier_8/t8_beacon.descriptio: A nether star, obsidian and glass. Build a pyramid for its powers.
quest.island_tier_8/t8_beacon.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_8/t8_beacon.title: Beacon
quest.island_tier_8/t8_naga.description: The Twilight Forest's first boss lives in a courtyard. Plan to beat it within one 15-minute expedition.
quest.island_tier_8/t8_naga.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_8/t8_naga.title: The Naga
quest.island_tier_8/t8_nether_star.title: Nether Star
quest.island_tier_8/t8_nitro.description: A nether star energized with redstone and blazing crystals.
quest.island_tier_8/t8_nitro.subtitle: Optional
quest.island_tier_8/t8_nitro.title: Nitro Crystals
quest.island_tier_8/t8_supremium.descrip: The top Mystical Agriculture essence: Inferium -> Prudentium -> Tertium -> Imperium -> Supremium, each step with an infusion crystal.
Infusion crystals need prosperity shards: OneBlock Engineering phase, or Nether prosperity ore on Nether expeditions.
quest.island_tier_8/t8_supremium.title: Supremium
quest.island_tier_8/t8_wither.descriptio: Three wither skeleton skulls on four soul sand: the previous expansion gave you all of them. Fight it in the End or the Nether, never at home.
quest.island_tier_8/t8_wither.subtitle: Main objective
quest.island_tier_8/t8_wither.title: The Wither
quest.lost_beyond_the_portal/become_trap: Stay in a realm past your 15 minutes: your Return Gateway collapses into crying obsidian and a Dormant Dimensional Fracture appears nearby. Teleport commands are blocked while you are trapped.
Stranded when the return route collapses
quest.lost_beyond_the_portal/escape_rift: Step into the stabilized fracture to return to your island.
Return home through a repaired fracture
quest.lost_beyond_the_portal/repair_frac: Find the fracture with your Rift Compass. Rift Guardians gather around it: each drops 2 Dimensional Fragments. Right-click the fracture with fragments (4 or more, depending on your island) to stabilize it.
Charge the dormant rift with 4 fragments
quest.magic_and_technology/arcane_enchan: Diamonds, obsidian and a book make an Enchanting Table.
quest.magic_and_technology/expedition_ki: Keep Dimensional Fragments with you so a fracture never holds you for long.
quest.the_dimensional_gateway/enter_gate: Step into the gateway while it is open. You have 15 minutes from your entry; a Return Gateway waits where you arrive.
Young islands go to gentle realms; harsher ones open as your island expands (see /dc status).
quest.the_dimensional_gateway/interdimen: Dimensional Fragments are your way home: only the Rift Guardians around a fracture drop them. You can also craft them from quartz, amethyst and glowstone. Keep a few: they repair fractures.
Harvest resources from beyond the rift
quest.the_dimensional_gateway/return_saf: Use your Return Gateway before your 15 minutes run out. The panel shows "Return portal:" during an expedition.
Return before your personal gateway collapses
quest.the_void/attune_compass.descriptio: Craft a Rift Compass. Right-click it: it tells where your gateway leads, where your return gateway is, or where the fracture is when you are trapped.
quest.the_void/attune_compass.subtitle: Track the gateway and dimensional fractures
quest.the_void/attune_compass.title: Attune the Rift Compass
quest.the_void/awakening.description: Welcome to Dimensional Chaos. Your island starts as one OneBlock; the glowing gateway nearby opens to another realm every 15 minutes.
Follow the "Island Expansion" chapters to grow your island; this story line explains the rules along the way.
quest.the_void/awakening.subtitle: Your home above the abyss
quest.the_void/awakening.title: Awakening in the Void
quest.the_void/timber_and_stone.descript: Mine the OneBlock for your first logs and cobblestone.
quest.the_void/timber_and_stone.subtitle: Renewable wood and stone in the void
quest.the_void/timber_and_stone.title: First Timber & Stone
quest.the_void/void_farming.description: Hay bales from the OneBlock give wheat and seeds. Plant a small farm on dirt and water it.
quest.the_void/void_farming.subtitle: Cultivate crops before entering the gateway
quest.the_void/void_farming.title: Sustenance in the Void
